recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future changes to OperationOutcome issue coding should be handled as new work-group decisions rather than by reapplying the pre-FHIR-8449 CodeableConcept issue.code model.
issue_request: FHIR-8449 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core OperationOutcome change request from DSTU1 questioning whether OperationOutcome.issue.code should remain a CodeableConcept with a required binding or become a primitive code, while preserving an extension point for more specific local issue codes.
initial_application: Git-svn commit 8f9d370156502bee2cc1371a3c97f28a1588ed2a (svn revision 6027) applied FHIR-8449 by changing issue.code from CodeableConcept to primitive code, updating examples to use code values, and making issue.details the CodeableConcept place for more specific issue information.
additional_context: FHIR-8449 intentionally revised the earlier FHIR-5622 implementation. FHIR-5622 had made the old issue type/code a CodeableConcept; FHIR-8449 resolved the tension between a required IssueType binding and local codes by keeping issue.code interoperably required and moving local CodeableConcept detail to issue.details.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/operationoutcome/structuredefinition-OperationOutcome.xml defines issue.code as primitive code with required IssueType, issue.details as CodeableConcept with example IssueDetails binding, and issue.diagnostics as string. Current OperationOutcome examples use primitive issue.code and optional details content.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-8449 is the later Published decision that revised FHIR-5622's CodeableConcept issue.code implementation.
